subject.title: Support Azure Foundry GPT Realtime Talk via gateway relay

question: Should OpenClaw implement Azure Foundry/OpenAI GPT Realtime in the bundled OpenAI provider now, and should the first supported auth path be API key only or include Microsoft Entra from the start?
rationale: The remaining work adds provider config and credential behavior, current live proof is blocked by Azure quota, and the security boundary needs maintainer-owned direction before automation can safely implement it.

options.title: API-key relay first
options.body: Implement server-side API-key Azure Gateway Relay support now, with SecretRef docs and an explicit follow-up for Microsoft Entra/managed identity.

options.title: Design Entra together
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define API-key, Entra, and managed-identity behavior as one provider-auth design.

options.title: Do not bundle Azure Realtime
options.body: Decline bundled Azure Realtime Talk and document that it should be handled by an external provider/plugin bridge.

recommendation.title: API-key relay first
recommendation.body: Implement server-side API-key Azure Gateway Relay support now, with SecretRef docs and an explicit follow-up for Microsoft Entra/managed identity.

likelyOwner.reason: The GA realtime bridge and OpenAI realtime provider boundary history make this the best available product-direction owner from the inspected history.
